        "import cv2\n",

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from IPython.display import display, Javascript, Image\n",
        "from google.colab.output import eval_js\n",
        "from base64 import b64decode\n",
        "def take_photo(filename=\"photo.jpg\", quality=0.8):\n",
        "\n",
        "    js = Javascript(\"\"\"\n",
        "    async function takePhoto(quality) {\n",
        "\n",
        "        const div = document.createElement('div');\n",
        "\n",
        "        const button = document.createElement('button');\n",
        "        button.textContent = 'Capture Photo';\n",
        "        div.appendChild(button);\n",
        "\n",
        "        const video = document.createElement('video');\n",
        "        video.style.display = 'block';\n",
        "        div.appendChild(video);\n",
        "\n",
        "        document.body.appendChild(div);\n",
        "\n",
        "        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({\n",
        "            video: true\n",
        "        });\n",
        "\n",
        "        video.srcObject = stream;\n",
        "        await video.play();\n",
        "\n",
        "        await new Promise(resolve => button.onclick = resolve);\n",
        "\n",
        "        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n",
        "\n",
        "        canvas.width = video.videoWidth;\n",
        "        canvas.height = video.videoHeight;\n",
        "\n",
        "        canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(video, 0, 0);\n",
        "\n",
        "        stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());\n",
        "\n",
        "        div.remove();\n",
        "\n",
        "        return canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality);\n",
        "    }\n",
        "    \"\"\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    display(js)\n",
        "\n",
        "    data = eval_js(\"takePhoto({})\".format(quality))\n",
        "\n",
        "    binary = b64decode(data.split(',')[1])\n",
        "\n",
        "    with open(filename, \"wb\") as f:\n",
        "        f.write(binary)\n",
        "\n",
        "    return filename\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Webcam function created successfully!\")\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "S1h9G8qKX_JE",
        "outputId": "fe2d8968-caa2-4b43-cdd6-6f612fe20542"
      },
      "execution_count": 2,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Webcam function created successfully!\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },

      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "import mediapipe as mp\n",
        "import cv2\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "# Download the hand detection model\n",
        "!wget -q -O hand_landmarker.task https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task\n",
        "\n",
        "# Initialize MediaPipe Tasks\n",
        "BaseOptions = mp.tasks.BaseOptions\n",
        "HandLandmarker = mp.tasks.vision.HandLandmarker\n",
        "HandLandmarkerOptions = mp.tasks.vision.HandLandmarkerOptions\n",
        "VisionRunningMode = mp.tasks.vision.RunningMode\n",
        "\n",
        "# Configure hand detection\n",
        "options = HandLandmarkerOptions(\n",
        "    base_options=BaseOptions(\n",
        "        model_asset_path=\"hand_landmarker.task\"\n",
        "    ),\n",
        "    running_mode=VisionRunningMode.IMAGE,\n",
        "    num_hands=2,\n",
        "    min_hand_detection_confidence=0.7\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create detector\n",
        "detector = HandLandmarker.create_from_options(options)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Hand detection initialized successfully!\")\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "1rYHf5dkbwa1",
        "outputId": "43958d76-e9df-4f4f-fe4e-f9e8aacd2e82"
      },
      "execution_count": 4,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Hand detection initialized successfully!\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },

        "else:\n",

        "\n"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "image = cv2.imread(filename)\n",
        "\n",
        "if image is None:\n",
        "    raise ValueError(\"Image not found. Please check the image path.\")\n",
        "\n",
        "rgb_image = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)\n",
        "mp_image = mp.Image(image_format=mp.ImageFormat.SRGB, data=rgb_image)\n",
        "\n",
        "results = detector.detect(mp_image)\n",
        "\n",
        "if results.hand_landmarks:\n",
        "    print(\"Hand detected successfully!\")\n",
        "    print(\"Number of hands:\", len(results.hand_landmarks))\n",
        "else:\n",
        "    print(\"No hand detected. Please try again.\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "52_J9yOScIxw",
        "outputId": "82e8398b-67b3-4eed-ad34-92a034523286"
      },
      "execution_count": 6,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Hand detected successfully!\n",
            "Number of hands: 1\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "connections = [\n",
        "    (0,1), (1,2), (2,3), (3,4),\n",
        "    (0,5), (5,6), (6,7), (7,8),\n",
        "    (5,9), (9,10), (10,11), (11,12),\n",
        "    (9,13), (13,14), (14,15), (15,16),\n",
        "    (13,17), (17,18), (18,19), (19,20),\n",
        "    (0,17)\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "output_image = rgb_image.copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "if results.hand_landmarks:\n",
        "    height, width, _ = output_image.shape\n",
        "\n",
        "    for hand in results.hand_landmarks:\n",
        "        points = []\n",
        "\n",
        "        for lm in hand:\n",
        "            x = int(lm.x * width)\n",
        "            y = int(lm.y * height)\n",
        "            points.append((x, y))\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Draw connections\n",
        "        for start, end in connections:\n",
        "            cv2.line(\n",
        "                output_image,\n",
        "                points[start],\n",
        "                points[end],\n",
        "                (0, 255, 0),\n",
        "                3\n",
        "            )\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Draw landmark points\n",
        "        for point in points:\n",
        "            cv2.circle(\n",
        "                output_image,\n",
        "                point,\n",
        "                5,\n",
        "                (255, 0, 0),\n",
        "                -1\n",
        "            )\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))\n",
        "plt.imshow(output_image)\n",
        "plt.title(\"AI Hand Landmark Detection\")\n",
        "plt.axis(\"off\")\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
      "metadata": {

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "def recognize_gesture(hand):\n",
        "\n",
        "    index = hand[8].y < hand[6].y\n",
        "    middle = hand[12].y < hand[10].y\n",
        "    ring = hand[16].y < hand[14].y\n",
        "    pinky = hand[20].y < hand[18].y\n",
        "\n",
        "    thumb_up = hand[4].y < hand[3].y\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Open Palm\n",
        "    if index and middle and ring and pinky:\n",
        "        return \"Open Palm\"\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Victory\n",
        "    elif index and middle and not ring and not pinky:\n",
        "        return \"Victory\"\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Thumb Up - allow a slightly raised pinky\n",
        "    elif thumb_up and not index and not middle and not ring:\n",
        "        return \"Thumb Up\"\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Closed Fist\n",
        "    elif not index and not middle and not ring and not pinky:\n",
        "        return \"Closed Fist\"\n",
        "\n",
        "    else:\n",
        "        return \"Unknown Gesture\"\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Updated gesture recognition successfully!\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"

              "        const div = document.createElement('div');\n",

              "        const button = document.createElement('button');\n",
              "        button.textContent = 'Capture Photo';\n",
              "        div.appendChild(button);\n",
              "\n",
              "        const video = document.createElement('video');\n",
              "        video.style.display = 'block';\n",
              "        div.appendChild(video);\n",
              "\n",
              "        document.body.appendChild(div);\n",
              "\n",
              "        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({\n",
              "            video: true\n",
              "        });\n",
              "\n",
              "        video.srcObject = stream;\n",
              "        await video.play();\n",
              "\n",
              "        await new Promise(resolve => button.onclick = resolve);\n",
              "\n",
              "        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n",
              "\n",

              "        canvas.height = video.videoHeight;\n",
              "\n",
              "        canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(video, 0, 0);\n",
              "\n",
              "        stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());\n",
              "\n",
              "        div.remove();\n",
              "\n",
              "        return canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality);\n",
